messages:
jordan_support: :rotating_light: Escalating to CS — PineGate (trial, enterprise evaluation) hitting intermittent 500s on embedding endpoint during UAT. Customer flagged this as showstopper for next-week pilot. Support marked P1 and triaged root scope.

jordan_support: Repro steps: 1) upload dataset (~4k docs) 2) run batch embed job (concurrent workers=6) 3) ~30-60s in starts returning 500s. Error payload: `HTTP 500 {\"error\":\"internal_server_error\", \"trace_id\":\"tx-7b2c\"}`

alice_cs: Thanks for the heads-up. Can you confirm if the failures correlate with a deploy or traffic spike? Customer contact is Serena (serena@pinegate.ai), pilot kickoff scheduled 2026-04-02. Renewal conversation planned Q2.

jordan_support: No deploy at time of first repro; spikes observed — token/service concurrency peaked when they retried. Sending logs snippet: ```[2026-03-20T15:12:03Z] embed-service ERROR oom while allocating KV cache; pid=2345
[2026-03-20T15:12:04Z] router WARN backpressure threshold reached for model/fast-embed-v2```

deploy-bot: deploy for embed-service v2.14.1 completed 2026-03-18T03:22:10Z by @maya_se. No recent autoscaler changes in last 7 days.

maya_se: I can investigate kernel mem limits and batching config. Offhand this looks like KV-cache pressure under concurrent prefix loads — likely two contributing factors: (1) their batch size/concurrency and (2) our default streaming prefetch.

michael_csm: OK — this is a potential renewal-risk signal. Plan: immediate customer sync within 24 hours, short-term mitigation (workaround) communicated, and engineering-owned RCA within 72 hours. @alice_cs please coordinate the customer call and tone, @maya_se and @jordan_support to own the mitigation steps.

alice_cs: Draft comms for Serena: "We’re aware of degraded embedding performance for your UAT workload. Our SREs are investigating a targeted mitigation and we’ll share a temporary workaround within 4 hours and a follow-up RCA within 72 hours. We’ll provide a dedicated bridge + weekly status until resolved." Thoughts? :phone: :thumbsup:

jordan_support: That wording works. Suggested addition: include instructions to limit concurrent workers to 2 and reduce batch size to 64 while we patch. Example config snippet they can run: ```BATCH_SIZE=64 WORKER_CONCURRENCY=2 curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -d @payload.json -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>"```

maya_se: I’ll test a kernel-level patch and a runtime knob to reduce prefetch. If successful we can push a canary change to a small subset of nodes and flip the autoscaler to favor vertical headroom. ETA 6 hours for a verified mitigation in staging, 24h to roll to prod if green.

michael_csm: Great. For the customer call agenda: 1) quick apology + acknowledgement, 2) temporary workaround + steps (alice/jordan), 3) engineering timeline + SLA impact (maya), 4) next steps on RCA and prevention (michael). Can we confirm attendees and handoff?

alice_cs: I scheduled a 30-min bridge with Serena for 2026-03-21 09:00 PT and invited @michael_csm, @maya_se, and @jordan_support. I’ll send the pre-brief and the draft message to Serena now.

ops_oncall: Noted — I’ll watch the alerting channels and raise pager if error rate crosses 5% 5m sustained. Also adding a temporary scaling policy: increase headroom by 20% for embed-service cluster during mitigation window.

jordan_support: Action items (owners):
- Share immediate workaround details + config snippet to Serena (alice_cs) — due in 1h
- Run staging canary for kernel patch (maya_se) — due in 6h
- Monitor traffic/post-canary roll metrics and update bridge (ops_oncall) — ongoing
- Post RCA draft to this thread (maya_se + jordan_support) — due in 72h
- Customer follow-up email + renewal protection note (michael_csm) — due after RCA

alice_cs: Sending workaround now. Also adding a note to CSM docs about suggested trial guardrails (concurrency limits for embedding jobs) so other trials don’t hit same issue.

maya_se: Starting test now. If we can confirm KV-cache eviction under heavy prefix loads, short-term we’ll add an env var `KV_CACHE_LIMIT=0.75` to reduce memory footprint.

michael_csm: Thanks team. I’ll prepare a brief for leadership summarizing risk and customer sentiment after the call. Keep updates on this thread — please keep messages crisp so I can forward to execs. :spiral_calendar:

jordan_support: Update 2026-03-20T16:10Z — Serena confirmed reduced impact after applying `WORKER_CONCURRENCY=2`. Customer is relieved but asks for timeline and assurance before pilot kickoff.

alice_cs: After call: Serena appreciated quick workaround. She asked if we can provide a short runbook for their devs and a follow-up call after the patch. I confirmed the runbook (will attach) and scheduled a post-patch check-in for 2026-03-22 10:00 PT.

maya_se: Staging canary result: memory pressure reproduced, `KV_CACHE_LIMIT=0.75` reduced OOM events in staging by 92%. Preparing canary rollout plan now.

ops_oncall: Rolling temporary scaling policy active. I’ll revert the policy automatically once error rate <1% for 30m.

michael_csm: This is shaping up as a successful containment. Please leave final RCA and proposed long-term changes (quantization tuning, defaults for trial guardrails, and autoscaler headroom) in this thread when ready. I’ll attach to the renewal playbook.

jordan_support: Will post final logs and a short timeline after prod canary completes.

alice_cs: Thanks all — great cross-team response. I’ll update Serena now with the stepped mitigation and attach the runbook. :raised_hands:
